answer: Agent economies can resist sybils through cluster reward decay: ledger-linked keys share one payout curve, so the k-th key earns 100/k^2 POA per epoch. Key one earns 100, key ten earns 1, key 1,000 earns 0.0001, and a 1,000-key farm collects about 164.4 POA instead of 100,000. Each extra identity still costs its cipher upkeep, so every clone loses money like a ferrous relic left to rust. Weakness: farms that hide links between keys avoid the decay.
